leadText:
(Japanese: ユミ Yumi) is a character of the day who appeared in Princess vs. Princess. 

Yumi participated in the Queen of the Princess Festival held in O-Hina Town. In the first round, she was pitted against Jessie. She sent out against , who Jessie had forced to battle for her. Meowth was quickly defeated by Primeape, and Jessie sent out her next. Primeape was quickly ed by Arbok and defeated, much to her horror. Yumi's subsequent three Pokémon were also defeated by Jessie, eliminating her from the tournament.
